summary: random_regular(kSwitchToSimple) throws 'switching did not converge' on valid inputs: the configuration model gives three self-loops {0,0},{1,1},{2,2}; every swap of two self-loops proposes the double edge {a,b},{a,b}, which is rejected (k1 == k2), so the switching loop can never leave this state. Generator bug (not an SSSP algorithm): the input here is the generator parameters, so 'graph' holds the stuck configuration produced by the same seed with MultiEdgePolicy::kKeep.

found_by.test: differential:baselines agree on generated graphs: regular (keep/drop/switch)

expected: a simple 2-regular graph on 3 vertices, i.e. the triangle {0,1},{1,2},{0,2} (include/sssp/generators.hpp: kSwitchToSimple is 'simple, exactly d')
